description: Retires the reasoning budget contract. Agents cannot read their effective reasoning level, so the exact-cap directive stopped every execution that carried it, and Meridian's CLI never enforced it. Reasoning management is removed from the managed Governed SDD text; a project that wants a reasoning policy writes its own outside the managed blocks. It also states that a local main ahead of the fetched origin/main does not block integration.
delta: In docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md the entire 'Reasoning budget contract' section (the capability=reasoning-budget-contract v1 marker, delimiters included) is deleted, and the execution-evidence-profile v4 text drops its sentence about the task's declared reasoning requirement. tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md (task-blueprint v14) no longer carries the Reasoning and Reasoning justification fields or their explanatory paragraph. docs/LIFECYCLE_ORCHESTRATION.md (lifecycle-orchestration v9) no longer requires the orchestrator to configure or confirm a worker reasoning value. PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md (execution-assets v4) no longer lists reasoning profiles. Unmarked text that required choosing, recording, matching, or escalating a reasoning level is removed from the context policy, operator prompts, pull request policy, and execution evidence profile. Existing tasks that still carry the fields are not an error. The git-workflow block (v11 in the Governed SDD PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md, v10 in the three Lean Delivery workflow files) replaces 'stage from a clean primary checkout at origin/main' with: local main equals origin/main or is ahead of it with commits not yet pushed (pushed with the integration), and main behind the fetched origin/main is MAIN_BEHIND_ORIGIN.
verification: a Governed SDD project locked at 1.2.8 removes the reasoning-budget-contract block cleanly on upgrade when its copy is unmodified, and reports a blocking conflict when the block was locally modified
no managed Governed SDD template requires choosing, recording, matching, confirming, or escalating a reasoning level

a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs git-workflow v11 and a clean Lean Delivery upgrade installs git-workflow v10, each stating that a local main ahead of origin/main does not block integration and that only a main behind the fetched origin/main is MAIN_BEHIND_ORIGIN
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
